servinfo.title: Starting motor does not stop (cranking sound is heard)
servinfo.ptxt: Possible symptoms of starting system trouble are as follows:

item.ptxt: Starting motor does not run (or runs slowly).
Starting motor runs but fails to crank engine.

servinfo.ptxt: Proper diagnosis must be made to determine in which of the battery, wiring harness, starting motor (including magnetic switch) and engine the cause of each trouble lies.
Before removing the starting motor, check the following items to identify the most possible cause of trouble.

s1.ptxt: Tightness of battery terminals (including ground cable connection on engine) and starting motor terminals

condition.ptxt: Starting motor does not stop (cranking sound is heard)

ps.ptxt: Starting motor control relay stays on
Short circuit between battery positive (+) cable and magnetic switch lead wire
Short circuit between battery positive (+) cable and starting motor control relay drive circuit
